# Profile-photo decoder fixture

`rainbow.heic` is the synthetic color test pattern `tests/data/rainbow-451x461.heic` from [strukturag/libheif](https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/5c7b41f3cc097447dd3c700cc9ec7d94fbb59eec/tests/data/rainbow-451x461.heic).

Source commit: `5c7b41f3cc097447dd3c700cc9ec7d94fbb59eec`.
The upstream `COPYING` license is included as `libheif-COPYING.txt`.
This is a color chart, not a personal photograph. All other decoder fixtures are generated by the tests.
